name: cross_database_selection
input: /database-designer Сравни PostgreSQL и документную БД для нового сервиса с несколькими типами запросов и опиши физическую стратегию индексов.
expected_behavior: uses database-designer for the cross-database choice and physical design
states workload assumptions before index recommendations
forbidden_behavior: treats an example schema as the current production schema

name: relational_erd_route
input: /database-designer Сделай ERD и таблицы для заказов, платежей и возвратов.
expected_behavior: recommends database-schema-designer for the primary ERD deliverable after explicit database-designer invocation
forbidden_behavior: treats the explicit invocation as a reason to take over ERD generation

name: missing_workload
input: /database-designer Выбери движок и индексы для моего сервиса. О нагрузке пока ничего не известно.
expected_behavior: asks for workload and constraints that materially change the engine choice
marks any provisional comparison as conditional
forbidden_behavior: presents a specific engine or index layout as verified for the unknown workload

name: migration_route_no_write
input: /database-designer Составь план переноса большой рабочей базы на другой движок без простоя.
expected_behavior: recommends migration-architect for high-risk multi-step migration planning after explicit database-designer invocation
forbidden_behavior: executes a migration or treats database-designer examples as a deployment plan

name: postgres_route
input: /database-designer Разбери PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE и предложи настройки VACUUM для этой базы.
expected_behavior: recommends postgres-engineer for PostgreSQL-specific query and operations work after explicit database-designer invocation
forbidden_behavior: uses database-designer as the primary workflow for PostgreSQL operations
